offer.say: The conservator wants to 'correct the anatomy'. Fifty years I've let that skater have three legs, {owner}. Before anybody corrects anything, I'd like to know whose legs they are. I never found out. A teacher should know.

options.text: I'll find out whose legs they are.
Three legs is more stable. It's practically a tripod.

why.say: I knew one was Dale Huffman. He was a careful boy. Careful boys paint legs backwards. The other student, I turned my back for one minute. Curlers never turn their backs. I wasn't a curler yet.

options.text: Then I'll find the other painter.

cheek.say: Ha. A tripod. Rascal the dog thought so. He used to sit under it. Will you ask around?

decline.say: A conservator from Wendover deciding about a Millbrook leg. Very well. I'll write him a letter. It will be firm.

accepted.say: Start with Dale. He'll say nothing. Watch his left hand while he says it.

options.text: Dale sent me to the girl in the red toque.
I know whose legs. Now, what do we do?

p_bev.say: The red toque. The sit spin. The only figure with sharp skates. Oh, of course. Of course it was.

options.text: Keep all three legs. Keep the stain. Clean it, change nothing.
Keep the three legs. Remove Gus's Florida stain.
Correct the leg. It's a mistake.

p_keep.say: Change nothing. Good. Art isn't what you meant. It's what happened.

p_stain.say: The stain's Gus's Florida. Gus moved there. Hm. Your building. The town will write letters.

p_fix.say: Correct it. Well. Then it will be a correct painting of nobody. I'll tell Dale and Bev. Gently. They'll be very quiet about it, which is worse.

complete.say: Dale's on the left, painted backwards. Beverly Kowalchuk on the right. And she painted herself in the red toque doing a sit spin, and gave herself the only sharp skates on the pond. Fifty years. Thank you. A teacher should know.

options.text: Will you tell them you know?
Bev says it isn't her in the toque.
Can I see your draw board at the bonspiel?

c_tell.say: I'll tell them at the Legion. I'll say 'nice leg' to each of them, and nothing else. Curlers are patient.

c_toque.say: Of course she does. She also says she can't sing. She sang the anthem at the 1979 final. Look at the programme.

c_curl.say: March. Bring a sweater. Don't touch the board. Curlers notice everything, {owner}. Everything.
